slides.title: When I Was Young

runs.t: By the end of class, you can do these six things.
I can say what I used to do.
I used to help on the farm.
I can say what I didn't use to do.
I can ask Did you use to…?
I can compare then and now.
I can tell a habit, one time, or now.
I can write about then and now.

slides.notes:
Read each goal slowly. Learners repeat.
Goal 1: used to (I used to help on the farm.). Goal 2: didn't use to (I didn't use to drink coffee.). Goal 3: Did you use to…? → Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
Goal 4: then and now (I used to write letters. Now I send text messages.). Goal 5: a past habit (used to), one time in the past (simple past), and now (simple present). Goal 6: read a short memory story and write 4 sentences about then and now.
"We check at 7:25" = the Progress Check. It is not a test grade.

Listening script (the audio is coming soon; until then, read it aloud with a volunteer at a normal, friendly speed):
Narrator: Lesson three. Listening. Daniel and his mother, Teresa, are looking at an old photo. Listen.
Daniel: Mom, is this you in the photo?
Teresa: Yes! That's me with my sister. We used to live in a small village.
Daniel: Is that your house?
Teresa: Yes. We used to live on a farm near a river.
Daniel: Did you use to help on the farm?
Teresa: Yes, I did. Every morning, I used to feed the animals before school.
Daniel: Wow. Did you use to walk to school?
Teresa: Yes. It was far, so we used to walk for an hour.
Daniel: What did you do after school?
Teresa: We used to do our chores. Then we used to climb trees and swim in the river.
Daniel: Did you have a TV?
Teresa: No, we didn't use to have a TV. We used to listen to the radio at night.
Daniel: And did you have a phone?
Teresa: No. We used to write letters to my aunt in the city. Now I send you text messages every day!
Daniel: That's true. Life is really different now.
Narrator: That's the end of the listening.

Progress Check · 7:25–7:30 · 5 min. Individuals. Open the Progress Check page.
Part A: read each sentence slowly, 2 times. Learners check Then or Now. Then click to show the answer (one click per item, 1 to 4).
